# Module `dom`

The document tree (DOM Standard: Document, Node, Element). In a worker there is no document: the functions taking a
node see no live node, and those returning one return null.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: `api/dom.widl`.

## Types

### handle `Node` : `EventTarget`

A node of the document. A node created by the module and never inserted lives until Node_release.

Checked by the browser on every call (`lookup_Node`).

### handle `Element` : `Node`

A node that is an element.

Checked by the browser on every call (`lookup_Element`).

```
u32 CustomElements_pending()
```

The size CustomElements_take needs now (0: nothing queued): the engine sizes its buffer with it, as the take

### `CustomElements_take`

```
bytes CustomElements_take()
```

The queued reactions, taken: per reaction u8 kind (1 upgrade, 2 connected, 3 disconnected, 4 attribute changed)
and u64 element; an attribute change adds its name, old value and new value (u32 length + UTF-8 each) and a u8
of flags (1: there was an old value, 2: there is a new one). Each element stays pinned until
CustomElements_release.

Host: `CustomElements_take :: proc(c: ^Call) -> []u8`

### `IntersectionObserver_takeRecords`

```
bytes IntersectionObserver_takeRecords(u64 observer)
```

The entries waiting, 128 bytes each, little endian: target u64, time f64, intersectionRatio f64, flags u32 (bit 0
isIntersecting, bit 1 isVisible, bit 2 rootBounds is not null), 4 bytes of 0, then twelve f64: rootBounds,
boundingClientRect and intersectionRect as x, y, width, height. Nothing changes until IntersectionObserver_release,
so a call that did not fit can be made again.
